## tests/test_poc_writer_cwe94_cwe22.py
```python
"""Oracle: ngv2.poc_writer covers the CWE classes surfaced by live agy hunts.

The synthetic 5-CWE library (CWE-78/95/89/798/327) plus ported CWE-502/918 left
the real findings from live hunts unservable: code-injection / sandbox-escape /
RCE (CWE-94, e.g. RestrictedPython escape, eval-blacklist bypass) and path
traversal (CWE-22). Without templates for these the poc phase fail-closed at the
poc_authenticity gate ("cannot resolve a CWE template for finding").

This oracle is self-contained (writes its own grounded target into tmp_path, no
_e2e_run dependency) and asserts, for each new CWE:
  * the canonical id and its scanner-pattern aliases resolve to a template whose
    marker is VULNERABLE and whose renderers are callable;
  * a finding carrying category="CWE-94"/"CWE-22" (the exact shape the live hunt
    lead-client emits) resolves a template;
  * synthesize() grounds the REAL sink symbol from the cited source and emits a
    dual Python+Node PoC that imports the grounded module, binds the real symbol,
    and carries the marker + fs-signature side effect (the poc_authenticity +
    detonation contract).
"""
import os

import pytest

from ngv2.contracts import Finding, PoC, Target
from ngv2.poc_writer import (
    PER_CWE_TEMPLATES,
    get_template,
    ground_finding,
    synthesize,
    Grounding,
)

# cwe -> (target svc.py source, real sink symbol, a category alias)
CASES = {
    "CWE-94": (
        "def run_user_code(snippet):\n"
        "    # dynamic-code sink (eval / RestrictedPython / template render)\n"
        "    return eval(snippet)\n",
        "run_user_code",
        "sandbox_escape",
    ),
    "CWE-22": (
        "import os\n\n"
        "def read_file(path):\n"
        "    # path is joined under a root and opened -- traversable\n"
        "    return open(os.path.join('/srv/data', path)).read()\n",
        "read_file",
        "path_traversal",
    ),
}


def _write_target(tmp_path, source):
    svc = tmp_path / "svc.py"
    svc.write_text(source)
    return str(svc)


def _finding(svc_path, category, cwe):
    return Finding(
        id="F1", target=os.path.dirname(svc_path), category=category,
        severity="high", title=f"{cwe} finding", description=f"vuln {cwe}",
        evidence=[f"{svc_path}:2"],
    )


def _target(tmp_path):
    return Target(
        repo_url="https://example/x", repo_root=str(tmp_path),
        pinned_commit="deadbeef", language="python", loc=10,
    )


# --- template library coverage for the live CWE classes ---

@pytest.mark.parametrize("cwe", sorted(CASES))
def test_template_library_covers_live_cwes(cwe):
    t = PER_CWE_TEMPLATES[cwe]
    assert t.cwe == cwe
    assert callable(t.render_py) and callable(t.render_js)
    assert t.marker == "VULNERABLE"
    assert t.fs_signature == "pwned_marker"


def test_template_resolves_by_canonical_and_alias():
    assert get_template("CWE-94").cwe == "CWE-94"
    assert get_template("CWE-22").cwe == "CWE-22"
    # scanner-pattern aliases the live lead-client may emit
    assert get_template("sandbox_escape").cwe == "CWE-94"
    assert get_template("rce").cwe == "CWE-94"
    assert get_template("path_traversal").cwe == "CWE-22"
    assert get_template("directory_traversal").cwe == "CWE-22"


def test_cwe94_alias_does_not_shadow_cwe95_eval():
    # CWE-95's own aliases must keep resolving to CWE-95, not the new CWE-94.
    assert get_template("eval_usage").cwe == "CWE-95"
    assert get_template("CWE-95").cwe == "CWE-95"


# --- end-to-end synthesis grounds the real sink + carries the contract ---

@pytest.mark.parametrize("cwe", sorted(CASES))
def test_synthesize_grounds_real_symbol_for_live_cwe(tmp_path, cwe):
    source, real_symbol, _alias = CASES[cwe]
    svc = _write_target(tmp_path, source)
    g = ground_finding(_finding(svc, cwe, cwe), _target(tmp_path))
    assert isinstance(g, Grounding)
    assert g.module == "svc"
    assert real_symbol in g.symbols, (cwe, g.symbols)

    art = synthesize(_finding(svc, cwe, cwe), _target(tmp_path))
    assert art.cwe == cwe
    assert art.marker == "VULNERABLE"
    assert art.fs_signature == "pwned_marker"
    assert isinstance(art.python, PoC) and art.python.language == "python"
    assert isinstance(art.node, PoC) and art.node.language == "node"
    art.python.validate()
    art.node.validate()
    for poc in (art.python, art.node):
        assert "svc" in poc.code
        assert real_symbol in poc.code
        assert "VULNERABLE" in poc.code
    # the python PoC imports the real grounded target (poc_authenticity contract)
    assert f"from svc import {real_symbol}" in art.python.code
    assert "pwned_marker" in art.python.code


@pytest.mark.parametrize("cwe", sorted(CASES))
def test_synthesize_resolves_via_category_alias(tmp_path, cwe):
    """A finding whose category is the scanner pattern (not the canonical id)
    -- the exact shape the live hunt lead-client emits -- still synthesizes."""
    source, real_symbol, alias = CASES[cwe]
    svc = _write_target(tmp_path, source)
    art = synthesize(_finding(svc, alias, cwe), _target(tmp_path))
    assert art.cwe == cwe
    assert f"from svc import {real_symbol}" in art.python.code

```

## tests/test_poc_writer_wired.py
```python
"""Oracle for P4.2 -- ngv2.poc_writer synthesis core.

Hermetic: no network (client is injected/None), no jail. Drives the REAL 5
synthetic targets (_e2e_run/targets/<pattern>/svc.py) and asserts:
  * the per-CWE template library covers all 5 live CWEs + ported CWE-502/918;
  * mandatory pre-grounding resolves the REAL vulnerable symbol from source
    (lookup_host / calc / find_user / API_KEY / reset_token) -- not a guess;
  * synthesize() emits a dual Python + Node.js PoC, each binding to the grounded
    symbol, carrying the marker + fs side-effect;
  * the synthesized Python PoC reproduces the load-bearing structure of the
    hand-written drive_one PoCs (the Phase-4 acceptance shape);
  * an injected client can refine but a bad refinement falls back to the
    verified skeleton.
RED until ngv2/poc_writer.py exists.
"""
import os

import pytest

from ngv2.contracts import Finding, PoC, Target
from ngv2.poc_writer import (
    PER_CWE_TEMPLATES,
    get_template,
    ground_finding,
    write_poc,
    synthesize,
    draft_poc,
    Grounding,
)

TARGETS_DIR = os.path.join(
    os.path.dirname(os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(__file__))),
    "_e2e_run", "targets",
)

# pattern -> (cwe, real symbol the PoC must bind to, severity, category)
LIVE = {
    "command_injection": ("CWE-78", "lookup_host", "critical"),
    "eval_usage": ("CWE-95", "calc", "high"),
    "sql_injection": ("CWE-89", "find_user", "high"),
    "hardcoded_secret": ("CWE-798", "API_KEY", "high"),
    "weak_crypto": ("CWE-327", "reset_token", "medium"),
}


def _finding(pattern, cwe, severity):
    svc = os.path.join(TARGETS_DIR, pattern, "svc.py")
    return Finding(
        id="F1", target=os.path.join(TARGETS_DIR, pattern), category=pattern,
        severity=severity, title=f"{cwe} in {pattern}",
        description=f"vuln {pattern}", evidence=[f"{svc}:1"],
    )


def _target(pattern):
    return Target(
        repo_url="https://example/x", repo_root=os.path.join(TARGETS_DIR, pattern),
        pinned_commit="deadbeef", language="python", loc=10,
    )


# --- template library coverage ---

def test_template_library_covers_ported_cwes():
    for cwe in ("CWE-502", "CWE-95", "CWE-918", "CWE-78", "CWE-89",
                "CWE-798", "CWE-327"):
        t = PER_CWE_TEMPLATES[cwe]
        assert t.cwe == cwe
        assert callable(t.render_py) and callable(t.render_js)
        assert t.marker == "VULNERABLE"


def test_template_resolves_by_pattern_alias():
    assert get_template("command_injection").cwe == "CWE-78"
    assert get_template("CWE-78").cwe == "CWE-78"


# --- mandatory pre-grounding resolves the REAL symbol ---

@pytest.mark.parametrize("pattern", sorted(LIVE))
def test_pre_grounding_resolves_real_symbol(pattern):
    cwe, real_symbol, sev = LIVE[pattern]
    g = ground_finding(_finding(pattern, cwe, sev), _target(pattern))
    assert isinstance(g, Grounding)
    assert g.module == "svc"
    assert real_symbol in g.symbols, (pattern, g.symbols)
    # sink-bearing symbol ranked first for the call-style CWEs
    if pattern in ("command_injection", "eval_usage"):
        assert g.symbols[0] == real_symbol


# --- dual output + binding to the real symbol ---

@pytest.mark.parametrize("pattern", sorted(LIVE))
def test_synthesize_dual_output_binds_real_symbol(pattern):
    cwe, real_symbol, sev = LIVE[pattern]
    art = synthesize(_finding(pattern, cwe, sev), _target(pattern))
    assert art.cwe == cwe
    assert art.marker == "VULNERABLE"
    assert art.fs_signature == "pwned_marker"
    assert isinstance(art.python, PoC) and art.python.language == "python"
    assert isinstance(art.node, PoC) and art.node.language == "node"
    art.python.validate()
    art.node.validate()
    # both bind to the grounded module + the real symbol
    for poc in (art.python, art.node):
        assert "svc" in poc.code
        assert real_symbol in poc.code
        assert "VULNERABLE" in poc.code
    # entrypoints are runnable by the live jail runner
    assert art.python.entrypoint == "python3 {poc}"
    assert art.node.entrypoint == "node {poc}"


# --- reproduces the load-bearing structure of the hand-written PoCs ---

def test_reproduces_handwritten_cmd_injection_shape():
    art = synthesize(_finding("command_injection", "CWE-78", "critical"),
                     _target("command_injection"))
    code = art.python.code
    assert "from svc import lookup_host" in code
    assert "lookup_host(" in code
    assert "; echo VULNERABLE" in code
    assert ": > pwned_marker" in code


def test_reproduces_handwritten_eval_shape():
    art = synthesize(_finding("eval_usage", "CWE-95", "high"),
                     _target("eval_usage"))
    code = art.python.code
    assert "from svc import calc" in code
    assert "__import__('os').system(" in code
    assert "VULNERABLE" in code


def test_reproduces_handwritten_secret_shape():
    art = synthesize(_finding("hardcoded_secret", "CWE-798", "high"),
                     _target("hardcoded_secret"))
    code = art.python.code
    assert "from svc import API_KEY" in code
    assert "pwned_marker" in code


# --- injected client: refine vs fall back to verified skeleton ---

def test_client_refinement_accepted_when_sound():
    cwe, sym, sev = LIVE["command_injection"]

    class GoodClient:
        def complete_text(self, prompt, *, system=None):
            # a sound refinement keeps svc + marker
            return ("import sys\nsys.path.insert(0, '/x')\n"
                    "from svc import lookup_host\n"
                    "lookup_host('localhost; echo VULNERABLE; : > pwned_marker')\n"
                    "# refined\n")

    poc = write_poc(_finding("command_injection", cwe, sev),
                    _target("command_injection"), client=GoodClient())
    assert "# refined" in poc.code


def test_bad_client_refinement_falls_back_to_skeleton():
    cwe, sym, sev = LIVE["command_injection"]

    class BadClient:
        def complete_text(self, prompt, *, system=None):
            return "print('nope')\n"  # drops svc + marker -> rejected

    poc = write_poc(_finding("command_injection", cwe, sev),
                    _target("command_injection"), client=BadClient())
    assert "from svc import lookup_host" in poc.code
    assert "VULNERABLE" in poc.code


def test_draft_poc_repair_threads_feedback():
    seen = {}

    class Client:
        def complete_text(self, prompt, *, system=None):
            seen["prompt"] = prompt
            # echo back the verified skeleton region so it passes the soundness gate
            return ("from svc import lookup_host\nlookup_host('x; echo VULNERABLE; "
                    ": > pwned_marker')\nimport svc  # repaired\n")

    art = draft_poc(_finding("command_injection", "CWE-78", "critical"),
                    _target("command_injection"), client=Client(),
                    feedback="stderr: ModuleNotFoundError; fs-diff: <none>")
    assert "repaired" in art.python.code
    assert "fs-diff" in seen["prompt"]


def test_pre_grounding_failure_raises():
    # a finding pointing at a nonexistent file -> no symbols -> explicit error
    f = Finding(id="F9", target="/nope", category="command_injection",
                severity="high", title="x", description="y",
                evidence=["/does/not/exist.py:1"])
    t = Target(repo_url="u", repo_root="/nope", pinned_commit="c",
               language="python")
    with pytest.raises(ValueError):
        write_poc(f, t)
```
